what: The Manual reviewer on "Northside Electric Co-op, residential electric service, monthly bill"

parsed_output.quote: In household LA's, shelter costs (also known as “items of shelter” ) are mortgage payments, property insurance (if required by a mortgageholder), rent, gas, electricity, heating fuel, water, sewer, garbage collection service, and real property taxes.
parsed_output.reason_plain: Yes, this is a shelter cost. Electricity is on the manual's list of shelter costs, so someone else paying the bill directly counts as in-kind support.
parsed_output.reason_technical: SI 00835.020B.36 explicitly lists "electricity" among shelter costs. SI 00835.465C and SI 00835.020B.17 add that a non-household member paying a vendor directly for a household shelter item creates outside ISM. The bill is for residential electric service, not a business, so SI 00835.471 does not apply.
